# C.A.R.E交互界面 / The C.A.R.E Interactive Interface

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_1.txt:3219；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:839 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

ancrel.2068（on_colony_attackers_win，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:839）：玩家夺下一颗已运行“C.A.R.E防御协议”的行星（星球标志 care_defensive_protocols_run）——这是“行星机械校准器”故事的结局；该故事的前半（异常类别 ancrel mechano）属于另一个故事“anomaly-ancrel-mechano-cat”。

ancrel.2068 (on_colony_attackers_win, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:839): the player conquers a planet whose C.A.R.E defensive protocols have run (planet flag care_defensive_protocols_run) — the ending of the Planetary Mechanocalibrator story, whose first half (the ancrel mechano anomaly category) is the separate story "anomaly-ancrel-mechano-cat".

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

拆解C.A.R.E交互界面：该物种的人口被清除，行星改归占领者，旧国家被摧毁；选项“太棒了”：若尚无则获得遗珍“碎片整理者”（r_the_defragmentor）并得到200稀有文物。

Disassembling the interface: the species' pops are killed, the planet changes hands and the old country is destroyed; the option "Excellent" grants the relic r_the_defragmentor (if not owned) and 200 minor artifacts.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无分支。 / No branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无。 / None.
